text:
Grounding and subsequent loss of the fishing vessel Silver Cloud II (WK 80)
Location: Rubha Rodha, Lochinver, Scotland.
Accident Investigation Report 17/2026
Read our marine accident investigation report, which includes what happened and subsequent actions taken.
Summary
At about 0238 on 14 October 2025, the fishing vessel Silver Cloud II grounded on rocks near Lochinver, Scotland, after the skipper fell asleep while on watch. The three crew members safely abandoned the vessel and were rescued without injury. The vessel was subsequently lost.
Safety issues
- lone watchkeeping
- acute fatigue compounded by illness and insufficient rest
- ineffective watch alarm arrangements.
Recommendations
In view of the repetition of findings from previous Marine Accident Investigation Branch (MAIB) investigations, no recommendations have been made.
